definitions.gloss: pounded burdock root dressed with sesame
definitions.explanation: A New Year dish of burdock root that is boiled, lightly pounded to split it, cut into short lengths, and dressed with ground sesame and vinegar. One of the three celebratory dishes of {関西|かんさい}-style おせち{料理|りょうり}.

examples.japanese: たたきごぼう⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たたきごぼう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Tataki-gobo is indispensable in our New Year food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{黒豆|くろまめ}→黒豆：30552_kuromame⟧、⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧、たたきごぼう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三品|さんぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえる⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In the Kansai region, many households prepare the three dishes of black beans, herring roe, and tataki-gobo.

notes:
Written たたきごぼう or {叩|たた}きごぼう. From ⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ (to strike) plus ごぼう (burdock root): the boiled root is tapped with a pestle so that it splits and takes up the dressing.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Burdock grows straight and deep, so the dish stands for a family taking firm root and prospering. In ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧ it is one of the three celebratory dishes (⟦{三|み}つ{肴|ざかな}→三つ肴：30596_mitsuzakana⟧) served at New Year, alongside ⟦{黒豆|くろまめ}→黒豆：30552_kuromame⟧ and ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧; in ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧ its place is taken by ⟦{田作|たづく}り→田作り：30553_tazukuri⟧.
